title: Chord diagram
description: Flows between groups placed around a circle: each group is an arc sized by its flows, each flow a ribbon between two arcs. Undirected, a ribbon joins a pair of groups and is as wide as the flows between them in both directions (a symmetric matrix counts each relation once), so a group that only receives flows keeps its arc; directed, every direction has its own ribbon with an arrowhead. Hover a group to highlight its ribbons, hover a ribbon to read both directions; the legend hides / shows groups and the arrow keys walk through groups then ribbons.

props.name: groups
props.description: Groups (names or `{ name, color }`), in their order around the circle; groups only named by `links` are appended. With `matrix`, unnamed rows are numbered from 1.

props.name: matrix
props.description: Square flow matrix: `matrix[i][j]` flows from group `i` to group `j` (used when `links` is absent)

props.name: links
props.description: Flows as a list (by group name or index); takes precedence over `matrix`

props.name: directed
props.description: `false`: one ribbon per pair of groups, as wide as the flows between them in both directions (a symmetric matrix counts each relation once). `true`: one ribbon per direction, arcs sized by the outgoing plus the incoming flows (self flows ignored)

props.name: arrows
props.description: Arrowheads at the target end of the ribbons

props.name: padAngle
props.description: Gap between the groups, in degrees

props.name: startAngle
props.description: Angle of the first group, degrees clockwise from 12 o'clock

props.name: sortGroups
props.description: Order of the groups around the circle

props.name: sortSubgroups
props.description: Order of the ribbon ends along an arc: `auto` minimizes the crossings; otherwise the order of the groups, or by value

props.name: ribbonColor
props.description: Color of the ribbons without `color`: a gradient from the source to the target color, one of the two, or a neutral gray

props.name: ribbonOpacity
props.description: Opacity of the ribbons, 0-1 (hovered ribbons are more opaque)

props.name: arcWidth
props.description: Thickness of the group arcs, in pixels

props.name: ticks
props.description: Value ticks outside the arcs (labelled where there is room); a number sets the step between ticks

props.name: tickFormat
props.description: Formats the tick labels

props.name: labels
props.description: Group labels along the arc (`tangential`) or the radius (`radial`); `auto` picks tangential when every name fits; colliding labels are shortened or skipped

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the chart (the legend included); numbers are pixels

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the chart; numbers are pixels

props.name: renderer
props.description: Backend of the shapes: `auto` tries WebGPU, then WebGL2, then WebGL, then Canvas2D, skipping GPUs running in software; text is always drawn with Canvas2D, above the shapes

props.name: palette
props.description: Colors of the marks without `color` (defaults to the `--chart-series-1..8` CSS variables, then the theme colors)

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend; clicking an item hides / shows its slice, stage, series, node, bar, row or level

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip; `false` disables it

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the values of the labels and the tooltip

props.name: percentFormat
props.description: Formats the shares (labels, conversion rates, tooltip); `share` is 0-1

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale of the texts and numbers the chart writes (tooltip rows, accessible names, number and percent formats, calendar dates); built-in texts in English, Chinese, Japanese and French (English otherwise)

props.name: texts
props.description: Replaces built-in texts of the `locale` (tooltip rows, accessible names, "No data")

props.name: hidden
props.description: Hidden slices / stages / radar series / top-level treemap or sunburst nodes / sankey nodes / radial bars / bullet rows / calendar levels, by index. Makes the visibility controlled: legend clicks then only call `onToggle`, whose `hiddenIndexes` should be stored and passed back. Leave undefined to let the legend hide / show entries by itself.

props.name: animation
props.description: Entry and update animations (skipped when the user prefers reduced motion)

props.name: padding
props.description: Space around the drawing, in pixels

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the chart

props.name: renderTooltip
props.description: React content of the tooltip (replaces the default content)

events.name: onToggle
events.description: Called when a legend item is clicked (or the instance's `toggle()` is called), with the toggled index and every hidden index after the toggle

events.name: onHover
events.description: Called when the hovered (or keyboard-focused) mark changes

events.name: onClick
events.description: Called when a mark is clicked, tapped or activated with Enter

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: A square matrix and the names of its rows: matrix[i][j] flows from group i to group j, here the messages the teams send each other in a week. Ticks mark the values around the arcs when the diagram is large enough.

examples.title: Brand switching
examples.description: Subscribers moving between mobile operators, one matrix per year. directed draws one ribbon per direction and ribbonColor="target" colors it by the operator that won the subscribers; the net gains are computed from the same matrix.

examples.title: Market basket
examples.description: Categories bought together in the same basket. sortGroups and sortSubgroups="descending" put the biggest categories and pairings first, ticks={1000} sets the tick step with a compact tickFormat, and renderTooltip shows a pairing as a share of all baskets.

examples.title: Dark console
examples.description: The chart reads its colors from the CSS variables of its container, here a dark operations console, with a neon palette, thinner arcs (arcWidth) and lighter ribbons (ribbonOpacity).

examples.title: Module dependency matrix
examples.description: Imports between the modules of a codebase. directed draws one ribbon per direction with an arrowhead at the imported module; ribbonColor="source" colors them by importer, so import cycles (two arrows between the same modules) stand out. labels="radial" writes the names along the radius.

examples.title: Directed flows with arrows
examples.description: Navigation between the pages of a shop app. Arcs add up the visits leaving and entering each page; onHover reports the hovered ribbon's source, target, value and reverseValue, shown in the caption below.

examples.title: Focus on a group
examples.description: Co-authored papers between faculties. onClick on an arc keeps that faculty's ribbons and gives the others a neutral color through the link color, then lists its main partners; clicking a ribbon reports the pair.

examples.title: Controlled legend
examples.description: Passengers between airport hubs. legend={{ position: "top" }} toggles the hubs, and with hidden + onToggle the hidden list lives in the page, so the buttons can show presets and the caption adds up the routes still visible.

examples.title: Live service calls
examples.description: Calls per second between microservices, refreshed every 2 seconds with an animated transition. directed with ribbonColor="source" shows who calls whom; the caption gives the total and the busiest call.

examples.title: Migration between regions
examples.description: Each region's arc adds up the migrants leaving and arriving; a ribbon is as wide as the moves between two regions both ways, and its tooltip splits them (Value, Reverse). The diagonal (migration within a region) is drawn as a loop. groups sets the colors, format the unit, padAngle widens the gaps.

examples.title: Options
examples.description: Try the label modes (auto picks tangential labels when every name fits its arc, radial ones otherwise), the group order, the ribbon colors, directed ribbons and the ticks.

examples.title: Trade between economies
examples.description: Bilateral goods trade given as a links list ({ source, target, value }) instead of a matrix. sortGroups="descending" puts the biggest traders first; the tooltip of a ribbon shows the exports one way (Value) and the other (Reverse), formatted as compact US dollars.

ChordChartProps.groups: Groups (names or { name, color }) in their order around the circle; groups only named by links are appended, unnamed matrix rows are numbered from 1
ChordChartProps.matrix: Square flow matrix: matrix[i][j] flows from group i to group j (used when links is absent)
ChordChartProps.links: Flows as a list of { source, target, value, color } (by group name or index); takes precedence over matrix
ChordChartProps.directed: One ribbon per direction, arcs sized by the outgoing plus the incoming flows (self flows ignored); otherwise one ribbon per pair, as wide as the flows of both directions (a symmetric matrix counts each relation once)
ChordChartProps.arrows: Arrowheads at the target end of the ribbons (true when directed by default)
ChordChartProps.padAngle: Gap between the groups, in degrees
ChordChartProps.startAngle: Angle of the first group, degrees clockwise from 12 o'clock
ChordChartProps.sortGroups: Order of the groups around the circle: data order, ascending or descending total
ChordChartProps.sortSubgroups: Order of the ribbon ends along an arc: auto minimizes the crossings, otherwise the order of the groups or by value
ChordChartProps.ribbonColor: Color of the ribbons without color: a gradient from the source to the target color, one of the two, or a neutral gray
ChordChartProps.ribbonOpacity: Opacity of the ribbons, 0-1 (hovered ribbons are more opaque)
ChordChartProps.arcWidth: Thickness of the group arcs, in pixels (6% of the radius, 8-18 px, by default)
ChordChartProps.ticks: Value ticks outside the arcs, labelled where there is room; a number sets the step between labelled ticks
ChordChartProps.tickFormat: Formats the tick labels (compact numbers of the locale by default, not format, whose units would crowd the ticks)
ChordChartProps.labels: Group labels along the arc (tangential), along the radius (radial), auto or none; colliding labels are shortened or skipped

props.height: Height of the chart, the legend included: pixels or any CSS length
props.options: Other engine options (ChordChartOptions: padAngle, startAngle, sortGroups, sortSubgroups, ribbonOpacity, arcWidth, ticks, arrows, palette, format, percentFormat…); property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-hover: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) group or ribbon changed; detail: { index, name, value, percent, color, source, target, reverseValue }, null when nothing is hovered
events.minerva-click: A group or ribbon was clicked, tapped or activated with Enter; detail: { index, name, value, percent, color, source, target, reverseValue }
events.minerva-toggle: A legend item was clicked (or toggle() called); detail: { index, hidden, hiddenIndexes }

methods.toggle: Hides / shows a group by index
methods.getRenderer: Backend drawing the shapes (webgpu, webgl2, webgl, canvas2d), null until ready; set it with the renderer engine option
